title.rendered: More Than Conquerors Through Him Who Loved Us: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: In all these things you are more than a conqueror through Him who loved you. Not in spite of them. In them. Through Him. Today.

content.rendered:
In all these things you are more than a conqueror through Him who loved you. Not in spite of them. In them. Through Him. Today.

The Gospel For Today | Thursday, June 4, 2026

Today’s Scripture

“No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.”
Romans 8:37 (NIV)

Today’s Message

Read the verses just before this one and the picture is bracing. Paul lists tribulation, distress, persecution, famine, nakedness, danger and sword. He quotes a Psalm: for Your sake we are being put to death all day long, considered as sheep for the slaughter. He is not pretending the Christian life is sunshine. He is naming the worst case scenarios. And then he says: in all these things. Not when they are over. Not after they get easier. In them. Right in the middle. You are more than a conqueror.

The phrase Paul uses is one word in Greek, hypernikomen, super-conquering. It is a Pauline coinage. There was no Greek word strong enough for the kind of victory he wanted to describe, so he invented one. Believers in Christ do not merely win against the things that come against them. They super-conquer. They come out the other side stronger in faith, deeper in love, more rooted in God than they were before. The fire that was meant to consume them ends up refining them.

And notice the source of the victory. Through Him who loved us. Not through your grit. Not through your gifting. Not through favourable circumstances. Through Him. The same Jesus who went to the cross is the One whose love is now the engine of your overcoming. You are not winning by your own strength. You are winning by being held by the strength of the One who loves you.

This is not a denial of pain. This is a relocation of identity. Yes, the trouble is real. The grief is real. The pressure is real. But your identity is not victim. Your identity is more than conqueror. The Spirit who raised Jesus from the dead now lives in you. The Father who did not spare His own Son will not abandon you in this.

Whatever this week is throwing at you, you are not under it. You are over it in Christ. Not because of you. Through Him who loved you.

Prayer

Father, thank You that nothing I face today can separate me from Your love. Thank You that in every pressure, every grief, every difficulty, I am not just surviving. I am more than a conqueror through the One who loved me to the cross and through the empty tomb. Carry me by Your Spirit today. Remind me of who I am. In Jesus’ name. Amen.

Declaration

I am more than a conqueror through Him who loved me. Not after the trouble passes. In the middle of it. The love of Christ is the strength of my soul. The Spirit who raised Jesus lives in me. Today, I walk in the victory that has already been won at the cross.

Go Deeper in the Word

  • 1 John 5:4: The victory that overcomes the world is our faith
